import numpy as np

def avg_pose(name, n=5):
    ps = []
    q = None
    for _ in range(n):
        p, q = get_object_pose(name)
        ps.append(p)
    return np.mean(ps, axis=0), q

# Perception: average several queries to reduce ~1 cm noise
nut_center_pos, _ = avg_pose("white hollow center of the brown square nut")
peg_pos, _ = avg_pose("brown square block")

# Grasp pose at the handle (use its quaternion as-is)
grasp_pos, grasp_quat = sample_grasp_pose("extruded handle of the brown square nut")
# Refine grasp position by averaging multiple samples (same handle region)
gps = [grasp_pos]
for _ in range(4):
    gp, _ = sample_grasp_pose("extruded handle of the brown square nut")
    gps.append(gp)
grasp_pos = np.mean(gps, axis=0)

# Rigid transform from nut center to handle grasp, expressed in world frame.
# Since the end-effector orientation is held fixed during transport, this offset stays constant.
offset = grasp_pos - nut_center_pos

# Grasp the nut by its handle
open_gripper()
goto_pose(grasp_pos, grasp_quat, z_approach=0.10)
close_gripper()

# Lift
lift_pos = grasp_pos.copy()
lift_pos[2] += 0.15
goto_pose(lift_pos, grasp_quat)

# Target: nut center aligned over the peg (xy), same table-level height as pickup
target_pos = np.array([peg_pos[0] + offset[0],
                       peg_pos[1] + offset[1],
                       grasp_pos[2] + 0.005])

# Move above peg, then descend straight down to insert
goto_pose(target_pos, grasp_quat, z_approach=0.15)

# Release and retreat
open_gripper()
retreat = target_pos.copy()
retreat[2] += 0.15
goto_pose(retreat, grasp_quat)
goto_home_joint_position()
